summary: Kanzhun Limited, a Beijing-based foreign private issuer whose American Depositary Shares trade on Nasdaq under BZ, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 Interim Report as Exhibit 99.1, signed by Director and CEO Peng Zhao. The filing covers the month of September 2026 and contains no transaction, shareholder-vote, or corporate-action items; an interim report is the routine semi-annual disclosure equivalent to a US domestic issuer's quarterly earnings release plus periodic report. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. No special-situation or risk-arb angle arises.
